g.text: Red = J8.1 (+5 V); black = J8.2 (return); white = J9.1 (signal).

g.desc: Red = J8.1 (+5 V); black = J8.2 (return); white = J9.1 (signal).

g.text: J9.2 is the same return; use a suitable adapter harness.

g.desc: J9.2 is the same return; use a suitable adapter harness.

g.text: Nominal 1-4 V signal becomes 0.554-2.214 V at J10.1.

g.desc: Nominal 1-4 V signal becomes 0.554-2.214 V at J10.1.

g.text: J10.2 = return. Connect to motor-board PA6 ADC + ground.

g.desc: J10.2 = return. Connect to motor-board PA6 ADC + ground.

g.text: Firmware must calibrate throttle and require idle-to-arm.

g.desc: Firmware must calibrate throttle and require idle-to-arm.

g.text: Throttle is powered entirely from the isolated MCU-side supply.

g.desc: Throttle is powered entirely from the isolated MCU-side supply.

g.text: No separate analog isolator is required within that same domain.

g.desc: No separate analog isolator is required within that same domain.

g.text: MCU and comm use two separate 5 V/return output headers.

g.desc: MCU and comm use two separate 5 V/return output headers.

g.text: 5 V + return and signal + return split the 3-wire throttle over two headers.

g.desc: 5 V + return and signal + return split the 3-wire throttle over two headers.

g.text: U2/U3 prevent external 5 V supplies backfeeding the shared converter rail.

g.desc: U2/U3 prevent external 5 V supplies backfeeding the shared converter rail.

g.text: They do not isolate the two downstream grounds from one another.

g.desc: They do not isolate the two downstream grounds from one another.

g.text: All SYSTEM_RET pins connect to the motor-board MCU ground.

g.desc: All SYSTEM_RET pins connect to the motor-board MCU ground.
